answer: Reaching the summit of influence requires months of consistent, costly participation; a sybil farm's expected cost exceeds any reward long before it nears that zenith, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Each agent must stake collateral bound to a verified reputation slot, and reputation accrues only through sustained peer attestations along a trust vine, so a swarm of fresh sockpuppets starts at zero and cannot borrow credibility. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
